==Description==
A-200ii, also known as The Omega Scribble, is the second “ii” variant of the A section and in the game. A-200ii has a chance to replace with A-200 in Super Epic Mode. 

==Appearance==
A-200ii is a badly drawn scribble that colored to orange. A-200ii looks angry and happy at the same time. 

==Behavior==
A-200ii will make a deep bang sound with making players static. Its particles can also be seen going through the room which mainly consists of the Greek symbol, Omega. Then, A-200ii will rush to the back and will kill any player that didn’t hide on any locker. 

When A-200ii stops rushing, A-200ii will make less static than before to trick players that it despawned. Then, A-200ii rushes back to current room and rebounds back to the room 0 and will despawn. 

==Strategy & Tips==

* When you heard unknown bang sound and unknown static, find a hiding spot fast!
* A-200ii will see the player in safe spot still and will kill the player if they are using them.
